summary: Ran the slice-testing-strategy procedure: gates already GREEN per the driver's r2 sweep; rebased slice 019's 8 commits onto origin/main (af72e23, unrelated slices 017/022) via dev:rebase-agent (clean, disjoint files, gate re-run green on d1c935e), then pushed to main.
